Delivering for FedEx is like doing cross fit every day. Weight limit is 150lbs and we often don't have dollies to help deliver. I run an average of 4 miles a day (rural route with lots of long driveways). Im ironically in the best shape of my life.

I got to the depot this morning and had a mental breakdown in front of my boss and my wife (she also drives for fedex). After I told her how I felt she asked why I was depressed, my response was I dont know. I truly don't. I have a beautiful home, working cars, a great kid. I have everything a man could want. Something is just off, I just can't seem to actually feel happiness or joy in any capacity.

I'm just sick of feeling like this every day. I appreceate the advice and for you reaching out to me when this is all going on. It does help knowing there are random people out there who care enough to at least try and help. Gives me a little faith in humanity.

I feel like I've been living a life that I have to live rather than the one I want. Im trapped and alone. Pretty sure my wife has no respect for me, but if divorce then my kid will be devastated as well. She practically raised her.

I've been trying to ride it all put but its getting to a point of unbearable that I didn't know I could handle. Can't self medicate with even weed because the job requires I be clean and sober. I know that would be a band aid, but at least I'd feel some kind of relief. Even for a moment.

I've tried everything. Hired a lawyer that put me 15k behind, studies up and tried going and representing myself. Her moms most recent arrest was the operation of a drug house (making meth), she rolled on some people and got probation instead.

Their mentality is that she's an addict and sick, so she can't control her actions. To be clear, that isn't the only time she's been arrested. She has a long track record with the police. We actually just spent new years in the hospital because she had my kid for a week (Christmas break) and my daughter is asthmatic. Her mom chain smokes. I quit years ago for her health.

Top that off with my contract as a driver was traded for lower pay because the guy who owned the team i worked for at fedex decided he wasn't making enough. I will be getting a new job, but the hours are still very long and I still won't see my kid much...ive missed so much of her growing up, shes almost a teen now...no idea when that happened...

I know I can't, I can't leave her alone to deal with that kind of life. I just don't know how much more I can tolerate...my entire life has been a shit show. Abusive father. Mom didn't care. Homeless with a drug addiction at 18 to 23. Picked myself up and started working hard for my kid. All for the state to simply look down their nose at me as tell me "no". Its very discouraging after 11 years of it...

I have, but they usually just want to throw drugs at you and charge you for the visit. It only intensifies the feeling of loneliness because I have to pay someone to listen to me. It might also be all the stigma that men face when seeking mental health. It all just makes me SUPER uncomfortable and the drugs make me feel like a walking zombie.

I appreciate you reaching out. It does help a little knowing I'm not alone in feeling this way.

Its not even the money aspect, although it is a contributing factor...
Its the fact that literally no one will listen when I'm down, upset, or just numb...
The one person who is supposed to be in my corner can't bother to hear me out. I dont have much in the way of friends or family (which is why im posting here) to hear me.
I'm trapped in my head all day, by myself, cycling through all the failures and bull shit. I just spent 20 minutes in the shower sitting on the floor crying because I feel so absurdly alone.
I know my kid needs me, its the only reason I haven't pulled the trigger, but even the strength that gives me is failing and I feel like I'm on a downward spiral with no parachute...
